lesson.title: 3.4 No, I'm not.
lesson.unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
lesson.unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
lesson.goal: Answer yes/no questions with the negative short forms (No, I'm not. / No, she isn't. / No, they aren't.) and say what is true instead (They aren't swimming. They're running.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.4 Yes and No: A1 answers Is he …? / Are you …? with Yes, he is. / No, she is not.; A1+ 3.4 answers with the negative short forms. The one new grammar relationship is the contraction of am not and are not (I'm not, aren't), next to A1+ 2.4's isn't, in short answers (No, I'm not. / No, they aren't.) and in a denial followed by what is true (They aren't swimming. They're running.). A short answer keeps the person of the question.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 3.4 yes/no questions with be; A1+ 2.4 isn't; A1+ 3.2 I'm, you're, we're; A1+ 3.3 he's, she's, they're; A1+ 1.1 short; A1+ 2.1 the gym, the office and the pool.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say aren't as one syllable, AHRNT, with the final t; say I'm not with the m and n joined. Do not require native-like speed.
